sourceTransform.note: Original cover STL retains the historical rigid y=-0.01585mm transform. No scaling; full native STEP topology retained including USB open shells. This assembly alignment is checked against independent front/back/USB photos and not represented as a manufacturing measurement. limitations: Manufacturer cover STL plus officially shared S015/S015-DIP populated PCB STEP; model fidelity does not establish firmware support.
No physical hardware measurements; cover assembly translation and photographic alignment are not manufacturing tolerances.
Back PCB silk and pad appearance use the exact SKU official photo; holes, sidewalls, USB, battery socket and BTB remain real CAD geometry.
The retained cover is 17.7556x29.6240x5.5mm; it is not scaled to the official 18x29.8mm whole-product dimensions.
DIP adds two 9-pin headers at documented 2.54mm pitch and15.24mm row spacing; plastic width/depth and pin section are image-measured, not native CAD.
Native CAD display colors and photograph-based PCB/cover colors are appearance approximations; no calibrated optical or electrical material claim.

The separate front FPC carrier/tail is photo/video-supported simplified geometry; flex thickness/bend and visible RF-shield exact geometry are not supplied by CAD and remain unverified. No hidden traces, screws or standoffs are invented.

Official disassembly shows the real paper bridging the internal cover release relief below the FPC. This small documented internal bridge remains; no invented plastic fills the native hole. External paper edges are masked to the actual recess.
The 12mm whole-product depth includes derived headers; exporter CAD bounds deliberately report the5.5mm base module only. Browser bounds independently include every visible header.
